provenance.selection: top hit matched to nearest bottom hit within +-15 ns of the same bar group; SUM of the two amplitudes (mV). MIP = wall top-bottom coincidence on the beam long run 224503 (first 500 bunches); Y-88 edge from the source runs.
provenance.method: threshold = 0.5 * (MIP-sum Landau peak) per bar-group. NOTE this is a HALF-MIP philosophy (what was requested), NOT the 95%-efficiency-targeted scan in thresholds_run224460.json - the two are not directly comparable.
provenance.hv_state: SiPM at July operating point (arm A MIP ~1.4x lower than B/C/D - a persistent, likely geometric per-arm effect; see y88_report / slides).
caveats: thresholds are digitizer-equivalent mV of amp(top)+amp(bottom); map to hardware discriminator units before setting
per-group MIP peaks from a bump fit on 500 bunches; a couple of groups scatter (use the per-wall recommended value = median of the 4 groups)
no efficiency/purity scan here (that needs 18_trigger_threshold.py); this is the half-MIP point only
arm A sum-MIP ~50 mV vs B/C/D ~67-72 mV -> arm A threshold ~25 vs ~34-36 mV
re-derive after any wall HV change (23f) or an updated MIP run.

threshold_definition: 0.5 x MIP-sum peak per bar group [(1+2)(3+4)(5+6)(7+8)]
